content: Global market projections forecast continued growth for the ground engaging tools sector, with the worldwide market size estimated to expand significantly through 2035, driven primarily by the increasing demand for heavy machinery components across various industrial applications [31] [33] . While these macroeconomic projections reflect positive global trends, understanding the specific dynamics of the South African market requires a nuanced examination of the leading suppliers, their product portfolios, and their strategies for market dominance. The industry continues to face significant challenges alongside its growth.
